name: bada-qcrypt
description: Bada QCrypt — a quantum cryptography application whose cipher layer is written in the Bada quantum programming language. BB84 quantum key distribution (per-photon gate programs with Born-rule measurement, intercept-resend eavesdropper, QBER detection), one-time-pad encryption, an encrypted vault, and a quarantine room that seals text and files so that any tampering (virus infection included) is detected byte-by-byte and reverted to the sealed state. Self-contained offline HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
